item.text: I found the text is one sentence per paragraph, which makes this clean: each non-empty paragraph can get exactly one tab after word three and a shared right tab stop. Next I’m applying that to the live document.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import re
import uno
from com.sun.star.style.TabAlign import RIGHT

ctx = uno.getComponentContext()
resolver = ctx.ServiceManager.createInstanceWithContext('com.sun.star.bridge.UnoUrlResolver', ctx)
uctx = resolver.resolve('uno:socket,host=localhost,port=2002;urp;StarOffice.ComponentContext')
smgr = uctx.ServiceManager
desktop = smgr.createInstanceWithContext('com.sun.star.frame.Desktop', uctx)
doc = desktop.getCurrentComponent()

# Work out the writable text width for the current page style. Tab stop positions
# are in 1/100 mm, relative to the paragraph text area.
cursor = doc.Text.createTextCursor()
page_style_name = cursor.PageStyleName
families = doc.StyleFamilies
page_styles = families.getByName('PageStyles')
page_style = page_styles.getByName(page_style_name)
text_width = page_style.Width - page_style.LeftMargin - page_style.RightMargin
right_tab_pos = max(1000, text_width - 50)  # slight inset avoids edge clipping

tab = uno.createUnoStruct('com.sun.star.style.TabStop')
tab.Position = int(right_tab_pos)
tab.Alignment = RIGHT
tab.DecimalChar = '.'
tab.FillChar = ' '

changed = 0
for para in doc.Text.createEnumeration():
    if not para.supportsService('com.sun.star.text.Paragraph'):
        continue
    original = para.getString()
    if not original.strip():
        continue
    words = re.findall(r'\\S+', original.replace('\\u00a0', ' '))
    if len(words) < 3:
        continue
    new_text = ' '.join(words[:3]) + '\\t' + ' '.join(words[3:])
    para.setString(new_text)
    para.ParaTabStops = (tab,)
    para.ParaAdjust = 0  # left paragraph alignment; tab handles the right side
    changed += 1

# Put the view back on the document and force a repaint.
doc.CurrentController.getFrame().getContainerWindow().setFocus()
print(f'changed {changed} paragraphs; right tab {right_tab_pos/100:.2f} mm')
PY"
